source_text: XV. Ἀναπέμψαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ τὸ ἀμὴν καὶ πληρώσαντος τὴν εὐχήν, οἱ τοῦ πυρὸς ἄνθρωποι ἐξῆψαν τὸ πῦρ. Μεγάλης δὲ ἐκλαμψάσης φλογὸς θαῦμα εἴδομεν, οἷς ἰδεῖν ἐδόθη· οἳ καὶ ἐτηρήθημεν εἰς τὸ ἀναγγεῖλαι τοῖς λοιποῖς τὰ γενόμενα. Τὸ γὰρ πῦρ καμάρας εἶδος ποιῆσαν, ὥσπερ ὀθόνη πλοίου ὑπὸ πνεύματος πληρουμένη, κύκλῳ περιετείχισεν τὸ σῶμα τοῦ μάρτυρος· καὶ ἦν μέσον οὐχ ὡς σὰρξ καιομένη, ἀλλ᾽ ὡς ἄρτος ὀπτώμενος, ἢ ὡς χρυσὸς καὶ ἄργυρος ἐν καμίνῳ πυρούμενος. Καὶ γὰρ εὐωδίας τοσαύτης ἀντελαβόμεθα, ὡς λιβανωτοῦ πνέοντος ἢ ἄλλου τινὸς τῶν τιμίων ἀρωμάτων.
thought_title: The fire walls around the body like a sail
orientation: The Smyrnaean letter writers narrate what happened after Polycarp finished his prayer on the pyre.
pass_a_gloss: And when he had sent up the amen and had completed the prayer, the men of the fire kindled the fire. And when a great flame had shone forth, we saw a wonder, we to whom it was given to see; and we were also kept to report to the rest the things that happened. For the fire, having made a shape of a vault, like a sail of a ship being filled by wind, walled around in a circle the body of the martyr; and he was in the middle not as flesh being burned, but as bread being baked, or as gold and silver being heated in a furnace. For we perceived so great fragrance, as of frankincense breathing or of some other one of the precious spices.

choices.why: literal genitive construction for attendants in charge of the pyre

choices.english: having made a shape of a vault
choices.why: keeps ποιῆσαν as action and εἶδος as shape, not a simile of being like an oven

choices.english: a sail of a ship being filled by wind
choices.why: preserves passive participle and agent ὑπὸ πνεύματος

pass_b_english: When he had uttered his Amen and finished his prayer, the men in charge of the fire lit it. A great flame blazed up, and we who were granted to see it beheld a wonder. We too were spared to report to the rest what happened. The fire shaped itself like a vault and walled the martyr's body round about, like a ship's sail swelling with the wind. And he stood in the middle, not like flesh burning but like bread baking, or like gold and silver glowing in a furnace. And we caught so rich a fragrance, as of breathing incense or some other precious spice.
